subject.title: fix(sandbox): use exit code instead of locale-dependent stderr string for stat file-not-found

question: Does the sandbox security owner approve classifying ENOENT by pinning `stat` to the C locale and mapping its diagnostic suffix to a private exit-code-2/stdout sentinel?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and preserves path anchoring and non-ENOENT failures, but the repository explicitly assigns this sandbox subtree to secops ownership.

options.title: Approve sentinel contract
options.body: Accept the bounded shell-level ENOENT classification after the branch and PR description are refreshed and exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Require another mechanism
options.body: Request a different structured errno mechanism if secops does not want diagnostic parsing inside the sandbox command plan.

recommendation.title: Approve sentinel contract
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded shell-level ENOENT classification after the branch and PR description are refreshed and exact-head checks pass.
